title: Square-Root Range Additions
statement:
Use square-root decomposition with per-block offsets to support range additions and point reads.

Input
n q, then n initial values. ADD L R x adds x to all indices in an inclusive 1-based range. GET i reads one value.

Output
Print the value for each GET.

Constraints
1 ≤ n ≤ 200000. Each value has absolute value at most 10⁹. 1 ≤ q ≤ 200000. Each addition has absolute value at most 10⁹.
